def test_bug():

    response = Response(text, mimetype='text/plain')

    environ = {'REQUEST_METHOD': 'GET'}
    response.make_conditional(environ, accept_ranges=True, complete_length=len(text))
    assert response.headers.get('Accept-Ranges') == 'bytes'
